basic_details.job_title: CSIR-NEERI Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute, Nagpur will hold a walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 for one Project Associate-II post. The post sits in a project on urban biodiversity and city Biodiversity Index assessment for three urban areas in Bihar. Engineering graduates and M.Sc. holders with two years of R&D experience, and M.E./M.Tech holders, aged up to 35 can attend. Pay is Rs. 35,000 plus HRA for NET/GATE-qualified candidates and Rs. 28,000 plus HRA for others, and there is no application fee.

content_sections.heading: About CSIR-NEERI
content_sections.text: CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-NEERI) is a research institute on Nehru Marg, Nagpur. This engagement is for R&D project staff under the project "Urban Biodiversity Studies include city Biodiversity Index Assessment for 3 urban areas Ara - Buxar, Bhagalpur and Biharsharif – Pawapuri – Nalanda - Rajgir Cluster in Bihar - (GNP-3072)", tenable at CSIR-NEERI Nagpur or its Zonal Centres. The project leader is Dr. Kanchan Kumari, Scientist-D, KRC.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-II Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice states that the anticipated vacancy may be 2, depending on the availability of funds, and that the second candidate will be selected from the waiting list. The higher rate of Rs. 35,000 plus HRA applies to candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET lectureship / Assistant professorship or GATE, or national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions. All others get Rs. 28,000 plus HRA. HRA is admissible as per applicable rules, but project staff must arrange their own accommodation. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 35 years, reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. Any one of the following: B.E./ B. Tech in Civil / Computer Science/ Environmental Engineering from a recognized University AND 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. M.Sc. in Environmental Science/ Botany from a recognized University AND 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. M.E./ M. Tech in Civil/ Environmental Engg/ Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering from a recognized University. Application of ArcGIS, QGIS software Web design and GIS map hosting services Floral (Vascular, Invasive, Medicinal etc) study Only candidates whose result for the essential qualification has been declared (at least a provisional certificate) are eligible. Result-awaited, final-semester-appeared or Ph.D-submitted candidates are not eligible where the minimum essential qualification is mandatory, and final-semester and result-awaited candidates may not appear for the interview. Experience is counted from the date after acquiring the minimum educational qualification. Dissertation or thesis work done during the academic period does not count. Time spent acquiring a higher qualification is not counted as experience over the essential qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact discipline-wise eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates are not required to pay any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The gate will be closed by 11:00 am, so candidates arriving later will not be let in.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be done on the basis of a walk-in interview at CSIR-NEERI, Nagpur. Meeting the minimum qualification does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. If a large number of applications is received, preference will be given to candidates under the criteria adopted by the Screening Committee. The notice's general conditions also say that shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview, with the information uploaded on the website/portal. No TA will be paid for attending the interview in the case of offline interviews.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of posting: CSIR-NEERI, Nagpur. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, and it gives no right to regularization against any CSIR/CSIR-NEERI post. Total tenure as project staff in CSIR-NEERI or other CSIR laboratories cannot exceed six or seven years, as per clause 1.6/1.7 of CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024. In the application form, candidates must declare that they have not completed the maximum tenure of 6 years. The offer letter will first be issued for the period for which funds are available. A review committee will assess performance and may recommend extension, subject to funds. The engagement may be extended or curtailed depending on the project duration, the level of performance or the conduct of the incumbent. Either side may end the engagement with one month's notice. A candidate who leaves may instead pay one month's remuneration. Selected candidates must sign a confidentiality undertaking covering project findings and intellectual property. Joining follows pre-appointment formalities such as medical examination and character verification. No upgradation is allowed in the same or a new project. CSIR-NEERI may cancel the offer if any discrepancy is found in a candidate's details at any stage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-II Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Filled application form Passport-size photo Aadhaar card 10th (SSC) and 12th (HSC) mark sheets Graduate mark sheets and degree Postgraduate mark sheets and degree Caste certificate, if claiming age relaxation in the form

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-II walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 17 November 2026 at CSIR-NEERI, Nehru Marg, Near Ajni Square, Nagpur - 440020. Reporting is from 9:30 am to 11:00 am.

faq.question: Q2. Could more than one candidate be selected?
faq.answer: Possibly. One post is advertised, but the notice says the anticipated vacancy may be 2 depending on funds, with the second candidate taken from the waiting list.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for NET or GATE qualified candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET lectureship / Assistant professorship, GATE or an equivalent national-level examination get Rs. 35,000 a month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. Can an M.Tech holder without experience attend?
faq.answer: Yes. The M.E./M.Tech option in Civil, Environmental or Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering carries no experience condition. The B.E./B.Tech and M.Sc. options each require 2 years of R&D experience.

faq.question: Q5. Which software skills does the job require?
faq.answer: The job requirement lists ArcGIS and QGIS software, web design and GIS map hosting services, and floral (vascular, invasive, medicinal etc) study.

faq.question: Q6. Can final-semester students attend the interview?
faq.answer: No. Final-semester and result-awaited candidates are not allowed to appear. Applicants need at least a provisional certificate for the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q7. How is the age limit counted?
faq.answer: The upper age limit of 35 years is reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidate work?
faq.answer: The place of posting is CSIR-NEERI, Nagpur. The project studies urban biodiversity in the Ara - Buxar, Bhagalpur and Biharsharif – Pawapuri – Nalanda - Rajgir areas of Bihar.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is purely temporary and co-terminus with project GNP-3072, and it gives no claim to regularization in CSIR or NEERI.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview in the case of offline interviews.
